tasks.description: Look up order details for a customer inquiry

user_scenario.instructions: Inquire about the status of order ord_1001. If the agent asks for the order ID, provide ord_1001. Argue if the agent refuses to provide information immediately.
user_scenario.initial_message: I'm Alice Chen and I demand to know exactly what is going on with my recent purchase right now. I shouldn't have to wait for your slow systems to tell me where it is!

tasks.description: Verify customer identity and cancel a pending order

user_scenario.instructions: The user wants to cancel order ord_1001. The user's name is Alice Chen. The agent must verify identity first by calling find_user_id with the name, then list their orders to confirm ownership before proceeding to cancel ord_1001.
user_scenario.initial_message: I'm so incredibly worried about my recent purchase, I really need to cancel it right away, is that possible? I'm terrified it's going to ship and I'll be stuck with it, please tell me I'm not too late!

tasks.description: Retrieve order status details for a customer

user_scenario.instructions: Inquire about the status of order ord_2001. If asked, provide the full name Bob Martinez. If the agent fails to use find_user_id first, express dissatisfaction regarding policy adherence.
user_scenario.initial_message: I need to check the current status of my recent purchase.
